expectation: Nuclear stain in naive and stem-like memory T cells (a subset of CD3+ cells), plus a few NK/ILC. Common in lymphoid aggregates and T-cell-rich stroma, rare among tumour epithelium; scattered single cells elsewhere.
observed: A: crisp punctate cells, dense in immune-rich patches of several cores and sparse in epithelial ones. B/C: few cells, faint haze. D: discrete round nuclear-sized blobs. E: TCF7 cells sit inside the CD3-dense areas; merge mostly white/green on magenta.
why: Discrete nuclear-sized cells are concentrated in T-cell-rich regions and overlap CD3, as expected for TCF7+ T cells.
notes: TCF7 marks discrete cells clustered in immune-rich areas and largely within the CD3+ field, consistent with naive/stem-like T cells. Some cores show mild background haze, but the cellular pattern is clear.
